incident-bot: PAGER -> Severity 2: model-quality anomaly detected for model redwood-v2b-prod in prod-us-central. Error rate on reranker +18%, quality delta -0.12 vs baseline. trace=0x7f4a

maya (oncall): I'm on it. digging into recent deploys. eli, any deploys in the last 30m?

eli (infra): Rolled out model variant redwood-v2b-prod:quant-16 at 00:12 UTC to us-central canary (25% traffic). No infra changes.

sarah (ml): Seeing spike on prompt family "order-summary" — hallucination uptick and lower coherence. Recommend reverting canary.

dan (sre): Initiating mitigations: 1) pin routing to stable, 2) switch fallback to redwood-v2a-stable, 3) pause canary.

maya (oncall): Commands I'll run:
```
redwoodctl model pin --model redwood-v2a-stable --selector 'prod-us-*'
redwoodctl rollback --deployment redwood-v2b-prod --to redwood-v2a-stable
``` 
I'll update when done.

incident-bot: ACTION -> rollback started by maya (oncall) at 1979012360

maya (oncall): Pin applied. rollback in progress. pausing canary. watching metrics (5m window).

sarah (ml): Quick eval locally: v2b decreases BLEU and raises hallucination on ~60% of order-summary evals. Hotfix pin recommended + block further rollout.

carla (cs): Drafting customer note for affected customers (finance, payments). Will post to status page once rollback confirmed.

maya (oncall): Status page draft:
"We detected a quality regression in model redwood-v2b affecting a subset of text-generation requests. Traffic was reverted to redwood-v2a-stable at ~00:14 UTC. If you see unexpected outputs, please contact support with request IDs."

carla (cs): SGTM. adding mitigation suggestions: re-run calls, set temperature lower for critical flows.

dan (sre): Metrics returning to baseline after rollback. latency stable. Error rate trending down.

maya (oncall): Handoff to eli for overnight monitoring. Handoff notes: rollback completed, v2a pinned in us-central, canary paused. Escalate to SRE lead if quality delta > 5% persists. runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/model-regression

eli (infra): Taking over. I'll run 1h checks and alert if anomaly >5% for 15m.

sarah (ml): Filing postmortem ticket INC-2026-305. Plan: reproduce, compare attention/kv cache differences, check tokenization/quantization side-effects. Owner: sarah (ml).

maya (oncall): Marking as mitigated/resolved for now. Please update thread with any follow-ups.

incident-bot: RESOLVED -> Incident mitigated at 1979012710. Severity downgraded to S3. Postmortem owner: sarah (ml).
